blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — A 56-year-old man tagged as Northern Mindanao’s second most wanted fugitive was captured in Zamboanga del Norte over the weekend, after months in hiding, police said Tuesday. In a statement, the Police Regional Office-10 (PRO-10) identified the suspect as alias “RK,” a resident of Barangay Diguan in Ozamiz City, Misamis Occidental. He was arrested last Friday, Oct. 16, by joint police forces in Barangay San Pedro, Dapitan City, where he had sought refuge following a murder incident in Ozamiz City in June 2026.
